rules.statement: A co-debtor who has discharged a debt secured by a mortgage does not create a real charge on the property in favor of the paying co-debtor for a proportionate share of the contribution due from other co-debtors.
rules.supporting_quote: Where one of the several co-debtors of a debt, secured by a mortgage, has discharged the debt, the property does not become burdened with a real charge in favour of the debtor who has paid the debt, for a proportionate share of the contribution due from the others.
